title: LING WIKI
content:
# Hi, I'm Ling ✨

🌱 Born on February 17, 2005, in China.

I'm a recreational programmer, open-source enthusiast, and currently a third-year Computer Science undergraduate.

I enjoy spending my time building interesting projects, exploring new ideas, and understanding the design behind systems.

I'm grateful to live in an open-source world. VS Code is one of my favorite tools. TvT

I’m always happy to contribute to fun projects and creative ideas. Feel free to reach out via email if you'd like to collaborate.

If you're interested in what I'm building, you're welcome to join me on this journey.

> "The mission of learning is to understand the design behind things."

> "Automate everything that can be sustainably automated."

---

For suggestions, ideas, questions, or feedback about this website, feel free to open an issue in the X-plore repository or send me an email.
